_about: Cluster field for the Hydra brand-mention sample: one Claude call per row fills context, summary and status. Equivalent to one cluster card in Step 2 of the UI (names 'context, summary, status', mode Default, reads from cleaned_text + original_title).

fields.prompt:
Analyse how "Hydra" is used in the provided text and title. Return a JSON object with:
• "context": what Hydra specifically refers to (2–6 words). Prefer the established name of the entity, product or concept. Use consistent labels for the same association.
• "summary": concise factual description of how Hydra is discussed (maximum 20 words).
• "status": one of:
"substantive": Hydra is the main subject or is meaningfully discussed, described or evaluated.
"incidental": Hydra is only named in passing, listed or appears in unrelated article links or navigation.
"unclear": Hydra is referenced but its meaning cannot be determined.
"irrelevant": no genuine Hydra reference exists, including unrelated words or text artefacts.
Use both title and text for context. Distinguish unrelated entities sharing the name Hydra. Do not confuse people with products, games or organisations. Do not invent information or assume Marvel. Respond in English with only the JSON object.
For "status", answer "unclear" or "irrelevant" rather than "unsure".
